reply.text:
Whether it's safe for you specifically is a question for your doctor, and I'd ask them before you start. That's the right first step at any age when you're beginning something new, and they can tell you if anything about your health needs to shape how you train.

From the coaching side, lifting is something plenty of people take up well into their 70s and beyond, and the usual approach is to start light, learn the movements, and build slowly over weeks and months. Good technique and a weight you could lift several more times matter far more than the number on the bar.

Once you've talked to your doctor, tell me what equipment you have, how many days a week suit you, and anything they say to avoid, and I'll build the program around that.
